headline.en: Barcelona open the league phase against Feyenoord at 18:45 on 9 September
headline.es: El Barca abre la fase liga ante el Feyenoord a las 18:45 del 9 de septiembre

summary.en: UEFA published the league-phase kickoff times on Saturday. Barcelona host Feyenoord at Camp Nou on Wednesday 9 September at 18:45 CET. That is the first of eight league-phase matches. The early slot leaves less recovery after a Liga weekend. The rest of the list is Galatasaray away, Paris Saint-Germain away, Aston Villa at home, Sabah away, Manchester City at home, Sporting away and Como at home.
summary.es: La UEFA publico el sabado los horarios. El Barca recibe al Feyenoord el 9 de septiembre a las 18:45. Es el primero de ocho partidos de la fase liga. El horario temprano deja menos descanso despues de Liga. Luego Galatasaray, PSG, Villa, Sabah, City, Sporting y Como.

body.en: The calendar is now fixed rather than guessed. Feyenoord at home is a manageable first night on paper, but the 18:45 start is awkward after a Liga weekend and before the next domestic midweek. Galatasaray and Paris follow as consecutive away weeks in October. Villa arrive in November and City in December, a stretch SPORT already marked as the hard block near the Clasico dates. Como at home later in the phase brings Cesc Fabregas back to Camp Nou. Flick asked for depth in August because this list does not offer a soft month. Eric Garcia's European ban removes one starter from the first night. The squad that looks large against Rayo will look tighter once those midweeks stack.

headline.en: Eric Garcia will miss the Feyenoord match because of last season's red card
headline.es: Eric Garcia se perdera el Feyenoord por la roja de la temporada pasada

summary.en: Eric Garcia is suspended for the Champions League opener against Feyenoord. UEFA rule 63.01 carries a straight red into the next European match the player plays. He was sent off in last season's quarter-final second leg at Atletico Madrid. The new four-yellow cycle does not cancel that ban. Jules Kounde and Xavi Espart are the options on that side of the defence for 9 September.
summary.es: Eric Garcia esta sancionado para el estreno ante el Feyenoord. El 63.01 de la UEFA arrastra la roja al siguiente partido europeo. La vio en la vuelta de cuartos en el Metropolitano. El nuevo ciclo de amarillas no la borra. Kounde y Xavi Espart son las opciones.

body.en: The ban is administrative, not a new incident. Garcia served nothing in last season's remaining European games because Barcelona were eliminated in that tie. The card therefore sits on the first night of the new campaign. Mundo Deportivo's Sergi Sole reported it on Saturday once the kickoff list was public. Losing Garcia for Feyenoord is inconvenient rather than fatal if Kounde is fit and Espart can cover. It becomes a problem if Liga minutes around that midweek also take Kounde out of the picture. Flick already used Espart at left-back in Elche. Using him on the right in Europe would be another emergency, not a plan.

headline.en: Livakovic trained with the first team on Saturday. Registration is the next step
headline.es: Livakovic entrenó con el primer equipo el sabado. Ahora falta la ficha

summary.en: Dominik Livakovic signed a contract until 2030 after a low fixed fee and add-ons to Fenerbahce. He trained with Barcelona's first team on Saturday. Joan Garcia remains first choice after two Liga clean sheets. Wojciech Szczesny is still at the club. Whether Livakovic is listed for Liga and the Champions League or goes on loan is a fair-play decision, not a football one. A fourth goalkeeper only helps if he can be named.
summary.es: Livakovic firmo hasta 2030 por una cifra fija baja y variables al Fenerbahce. El sabado trabajo con el primer equipo. Joan Garcia sigue de titular. Szczesny permanece. Si se inscribe o sale cedido lo decide el fair play.

body.en: The signing closed a week of delayed Turkish paperwork. Livakovic wanted the move and Barcelona wanted a senior option behind Joan Garcia after Ter Stegen left on loan to Ajax. Training with the group answers the first question: he is in the building. The second question is the squad list. Barcelona returned to the 1:1 salary rule this summer and still have to place Gordon, Adeyemi, Rodri and Cancelo on the Liga sheet. A fourth goalkeeper who cannot be registered is a cost, not cover. Until the ficha is public, treat the contract as signed and the role as unassigned.
